关于我的一些事(Something about Me): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
The kitchen is not far from my home.
The family dinner is big and clean.
I often play baseball after class.
In fact, peaches from that farm taste wonderful.
column3: 那个农场的桃子味道好极了。
